UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private profile and preferences for an authenticated WorldLens user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in WorldLens settings.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred WorldLens UI and scan response language.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

ScanRecord.title: ScanRecord
ScanRecord.description: Structured Gemini visual scan result saved privately for a signed-in user (text metadata only; no private photo bytes stored).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the scan owner.

objectName.description: Identified name of the scanned object, plant, animal, product, machine, or place.

explanation.description: Clear explanation of the identified subject.

characteristics.description: Bounded list of observable characteristics (max 10 items).

usefulFacts.description: Bounded list of useful facts (max 10 items).

confidenceLevel.description: Model confidence level for the identification.

confidenceExplanation.description: Honest explanation of identification confidence or uncertainty.

modelName.description: Gemini model identifier used for the scan.

sourceLabel.description: Whether the scanned photo originated from camera capture or gallery picker.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the scan was saved.

TranslationRecord.title: TranslationRecord
TranslationRecord.description: Saved AI translation entry belonging privately to a signed-in WorldLens user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the translation owner.

sourceLanguageCode.description: Source language code (e.g., auto, en, hi).

sourceLanguageName.description: Display name of the source or detected language.

targetLanguageName.description: Display name of the target language.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the translation was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and language preference document owned by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/scans/{scanId}.description: Private text-only AI visual scan history subcollection owned by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/translations/{translatio.description: Private AI translation history subcollection owned by {userId}.
